gizmo.title: Poloka ʻŌlelo
gizmo.description: He poloka ʻōlelo ʻōlelo ʻia me ke kaila.

configure.title: Kiʻi
configure.description: Kiʻi i hōʻike ʻia me ka ʻōlelo ʻōlelo ʻia.

advanced.title: Hoʻopahu ʻia
advanced.description: E kaha i ka ʻōlelo ʻōlelo ʻia ma ke kiʻi poloka like, me kahi kiʻi ikona a me ka lepili ma luna ona, i like me nā moʻolelo a me nā kāleka kuhikuhi.
